items: Article 32 is specifically known for allowing direct access to the Supreme Court for fundamental rights violations.
Extremely common question: Identify which Article was referred to as the 'heart and soul of the Constitution' by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar (Article 32).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 32 provides the Right to Constitutional Remedies, enabling citizens to approach the Supreme Court directly.
It ensures the active enforcement and protection of fundamental rights guaranteed by the Constitution.
Dr. B. R. Ambedkar considered this article to be the foundational core of the entire Indian Constitution.
